strategy.name: intraday_sma_final_local_plateau_full_history
strategy.description: 以用户冻结的最终 QQQ 参数 A=3、B=175、C=-0.25%、D=4、E=305、F=80±10、G=1%、H=270、L=10%、R=0% 且开启强制买回为基线，在完整批准历史上每次只扰动 B、E、F 中心、G、H 或 L 的一个维度，用 CAGR 与 Sharpe 的局部响应判断该参数向量附近是宽高原还是孤立尖峰。
strategy.buy_rule: 空仓时 OR：已有卖出价后，价格重新达到该卖出成交价（R=0%）则强制买回；价格向上穿越动态 H 日 SMA；价格向上穿越以 F 为中心、固定间隔 10 的三条短 SMA 平均值下方 G%。没有历史卖出价时，强制买回不能产生第一笔买入。
strategy.sell_rule: 持仓时 OR：价格低于成本价 L%；三短 SMA 平均变化率连续 A=3 日为负且价格跌破 B 日 SMA；此前连续 D=4 日三线平均变化率为负且当日三条短 SMA 各自变化率全部不高于 C=-0.25%；价格向下穿越 E 日 SMA。
strategy.signal_time: 每个交易日开始前只使用截至前一交易日 Close 的完整历史解出当日条件单阈值；指标预热不足时对应规则不产生订单。
strategy.execution_time: 若前 Close 到当日常规时段 Open 已越过阈值，按当日 Open 成交；否则常规时段调整后 OHLC 触及预先解出的理论阈值时按该阈值成交；每天最多一笔。
strategy.position_sizing: long-only；初始 100,000 美元现金，每次在全仓 QQQ 与全现金之间切换，允许小数股，不融资，现金不计息。
strategy.initial_position: 1999-03-10 起空仓等待第一笔普通买入；绩效从完整评价窗口起点计算，包含预热和等待首买的现金期。

windows.warmup: QQQ inception; no pre-listing history exists

sweeps.label: F 中心 · 三短均线中心（间隔固定 10）

plateau_diagnostic.interpretation: A point remains on the baseline plateau only if CAGR is no more than 0.50 percentage points below baseline and Sharpe is no more than 0.03 below baseline; only consecutive qualifying points connected to the baseline count.

financing: disabled; flat cash earns zero interest
benchmark: At the first regular-session Open of the common 1999-03-10 through 2026-08-04 evaluation window, invest the same 100,000 USD in QQQ and hold. Every OAT case and benchmark uses identical dates; the strategy's initial cash waiting period remains part of performance.

reporting.reuse_review: Reuse v3 unchanged. Add experiment-specific side-by-side CAGR and Sharpe line-plus-marker charts before the accepted performance and market figures; do not promote those analytical plots into the generic page template.
reporting.report_title: QQQ 最终参数全历史局部高原检验
reporting.report_subtitle: 围绕冻结参数，每次只扰动 B / E / F / G / H / L 一个维度；左图 CAGR，右图 Sharpe，菱形为基线。

research.hypothesis: 如果冻结参数不是畸形尖峰，则在用户指定的局部区间内，基线两侧应存在连续邻点，使 CAGR 与 Sharpe 不会同时快速崩落。
research.primary_metric: For each B/E/F/G/H/L sweep, plot all full-history CAGR and Sharpe values and report the connected baseline plateau under the predeclared 0.50 percentage-point CAGR and 0.03 Sharpe tolerances.
research.selection_rule: Do not replace the frozen baseline. Screen all 235 unique OAT cases; formally reconcile the baseline plus the CAGR and Sharpe maximum from every curve, de-duplicated by case ID.
research.validation_plan: Every formally selected case must match PyBroker and the independent pandas ledger on daily cash, shares, equity, order dates, sides, shares and fills within 1e-6; compiled screening metrics must match formal metrics; the first order must be an ordinary buy and daily trades must not exceed one.
research.promotion_criteria: This diagnostic can describe local smoothness but cannot promote the strategy. A favorable result requires a two-sided connected plateau for most tested dimensions and no visually isolated simultaneous CAGR/Sharpe spike at the frozen point.
research.rejection_conditions: Reject the robustness claim if multiple important dimensions are narrow/spike classifications, if maxima are isolated from the baseline neighborhood, if a requested range or step is implemented incorrectly, or if any accounting, timing, data, count, hash or browser gate fails.
